name: Optimus
def: Full size electric humanoid that Tesla is developing for factory and general labour tasks, currently used only inside Tesla facilities.
body: Optimus is a bipedal humanoid roughly 1.73 metres tall, driven by custom rotary and linear electric actuators with an 11-degree of freedom hand. Control comes from end to end neural network policies trained on video and teleoperation data, reusing perception software from Tesla's driver assistance stack. Tesla first walked a working prototype on stage in September 2022 and showed a lighter second generation in December 2023. Units have been shown handling parts inside Tesla plants and serving food at a company diner, but none have been sold to outside customers.

Announced at Tesla's 2021 AI Day as a dancer in a spandex suit, Optimus became hardware within a year and has since iterated through successive generations shown sorting battery cells and walking Tesla's factory floors. Musk has framed it as ultimately more valuable than the car business; the robot shares its vision stack with the company's driver assistance software.
facts: Walked unassisted on stage at Tesla AI Day in September 2022
Second generation announced in December 2023 with reduced mass and faster walking
Shown handling parts inside Tesla manufacturing sites and serving food at a company diner
specs: Custom rotary and linear electric actuators with an 11-degree of freedom hand
2.3 kWh battery pack housed in the torso
Camera based vision with tactile fingertip sensing
End to end neural network policies sharing perception software with Tesla's driver assistance stack
